title: DynamoDB Small Examples
description: Use these small DynamoDB examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Design the item key
examples.description: A partition key chooses an item group. A sort key identifies and orders items within that group.
examples.output: The low-level item uses reader as the partition key and book as the sort key. N values are represented as strings in this wire format.

examples.title: Create a local keyed table
examples.description: A DynamoDB table declares its key attributes.
examples.code: aws dynamodb create-table --table-name cma-books --attribute-definitions AttributeName=reader,AttributeType=S AttributeName=book,AttributeType=S --key-schema AttributeName=reader,KeyType=HASH AttributeName=book,KeyType=RANGE --billing-mode PAY_PER_REQUEST --endpoint-url http://localhost:8000
examples.output: DynamoDB Local creates the sample table with reader and book keys.

examples.title: Write a known item
examples.description: PutItem writes a complete item at its key.
examples.output: Send this to the local put-item operation. The item is stored at Mia's moon-trip key.

examples.title: Read an exact key
examples.description: GetItem reads one item by its complete primary key.
examples.output: The local get-item response contains the written sample item.

examples.title: Query one partition
examples.description: Query selects one partition key and can return its related items.
examples.output: The local query returns items in Mia's partition, ordered by their sort keys.

examples.title: Use a sort-key prefix
examples.description: A sort key can support a range or prefix inside one partition.
examples.output: Mia's moon-trip item matches the moon prefix.

examples.title: Read all result pages
examples.description: A Query response can be only one page of data.
examples.output: With several sample items, the response may include LastEvaluatedKey. Pass it as ExclusiveStartKey in the next request.

examples.title: Update one attribute
examples.description: UpdateItem can change selected attributes at a key.
examples.output: The local update returns the item with pages changed to 64.

examples.title: Avoid replacing an existing item
examples.description: A conditional put can require that a key does not already exist.
examples.output: The write fails with a condition error if that exact key already has an item.

examples.title: Understand filters and read cost
examples.description: A FilterExpression removes items after DynamoDB reads the key-matching data.
examples.output: Only matching items with pages at least 50 are returned, but the query reads the partition candidates first.

examples.title: Know that TTL is not an exact timer
examples.description: DynamoDB TTL uses an epoch-seconds attribute for expiry.
examples.output: This item shape has an expiry field. A real table must enable TTL on that field; DynamoDB Local does not perform the real background TTL deletion service.

examples.title: Remove one sample item
examples.description: DeleteItem targets one full key. A condition can be added when deletion must depend on the current item state.
examples.output: The local delete-item operation removes the specified sample and can return its previous values.
